name: Mythic Extra Ki (Mythic)
source: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats
book: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

facets.bk: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

body:
Your mythic power gives you additional points in your ki pool.

Prerequisites: Extra Ki, ki pool class feature.

Benefit(s): Your ki pool increases by 3. Additionally, if your ki pool is empty, as a swift action you may expend two uses of mythic power to regain one ki point.

Special: Unlike Extra Ki, you cannot take Mythic Extra Ki more than once.
